caption: The video captures a white sealant tube with a black label and green logo held above a glossy black surface. Its nozzle rests at the seam where the surface meets a white edge, extruding a continuous bead that runs diagonally toward the right. The bead stays joined to the nozzle throughout, indicating sealant is being laid along the seam. The tube and nozzle drift slowly leftward and slightly upward, so the bead's tip moves with them while the laid portion remains on the surface and the diagonal line steepens toward the right edge. A mirror reflection of the tube, nozzle and bead tracks this motion below, and a second white line already runs along the top-right back edge. A blurred dark hand shape sits faintly at the bottom center as the perspective shifts gradually.
